verdict.rationale: Vapi documents a speech configuration that lets developers 'control exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking,' so turn-taking timing is configurable. Nothing in the evidence shows whether this uses a model-based end-of-turn detector rather than plain VAD or silence timeouts. missing for 10: explicit evidence of model-based/semantic end-of-turn detection, documentation of how it handles slow or pausing speakers, configuration details beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
